method.identity: official positive and negative prompt scribble, eight deterministic farthest points per sign
method.path: shorter cyclic path over every registered RGB between prompt and target

interpretation.positive_mechanism: Registered prompt identity plus transient memory resolves large target-only over-segmentation on both horns and leaves.
interpretation.failure: Point-only prompt initialization can select an object part; unconditional video propagation then under-segments flower, fortress and orchids.
interpretation.next_gate: Use full signed-scribble-selected native SAM proposal extent at the prompt before temporal propagation, then require query-side reliability without target labels.
